title: Invite Brian to Speak
excerpt: Thanks for your interest in having Brian speak to your group. Brian’s speaking schedule for 2025 is full, and he will be taking a year off from public speaking in 2026, coinciding with turning 70. We plan to open a limited 2027 speaking schedule in mid-2026.
body:
Thanks for your interest in having Brian speak to your group.

 Brian’s speaking schedule for 2025 is full, and he will be taking a year off from public speaking in 2026, coinciding with turning 70.

 We plan to open a limited 2027 speaking schedule in mid-2026.
